content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

NOWPayments integration for static sites is a base-layer solution for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are restricted or unreliable. It combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. The system verifies transactions on-chain and triggers instant product delivery. Unlike workarounds, this is a sovereign stack: the creator owns the infrastructure, with no recurring fees or platform dependencies. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction, and Solana fees are fractions of a cent. This architecture is designed for creators selling ebooks, courses, or templates who need payments that settle faster than traditional platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in three layers. First, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts the static storefront. Second, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, processing orders and verifying payments. Third, NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, accepting 300+ cryptocurrencies and firing a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system is stateless: no customer data is stored, and no third-party APIs are required. This design ensures low fees, fast settlement, and complete ownership of the commerce pipeline.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Pakistan, and Venezuela, where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. It’s also for creators who want to bypass platform fees, payout delays, and data lock-in. For example, a creator in Kenya selling an ebook can accept USDT on Tron, receive payment in under a minute, and deliver the file automatically—all without relying on Stripe or Gumroad. The system is particularly suited for high-volume, low-margin products, where transaction fees under $0.10 make a significant difference in profitability.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction—ideal for high-volume, low-margin digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack relies on five core components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides free, scalable hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, including order processing and webhook handling. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. Each component is chosen for its cost-effectiveness, reliability, and ease of integration. For example, USDT on Tron and Solana networks ensure transaction fees remain under $0.10, making the stack viable for creators in currency-volatile regions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by setting up a static site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments by configuring API keys and webhooks. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery logic. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and host files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test end-to-end by simulating a purchase and verifying file delivery. How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for digital products, integrate NOWPayments with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. NOWPayments verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook to trigger file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. USDT payments on Tron settle in under a minute with fees under $0.10, compared to PayPal’s 2-3 day settlement and higher fees. This architecture ensures instant payments, automatic delivery, and full data ownership—no platform dependencies.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is lower than Stripe’s 2.9% + $0.30, with no KYC or buyer account required.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up a static site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and configure API keys. 3. Write backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery. 4. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Host product files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test the stack end-to-end by simulating a purchase. 7. Deploy the stack and start accepting crypto payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I convert USDT to local currency in Nigeria?
Use P2P exchanges like Binance, Patricia, or Yellow Card to convert USDT to naira. These platforms connect buyers and sellers directly, ensuring fast and reliable conversions.
What’s the difference between USDT on Tron and Solana?
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction, while Solana fees are fractions of a cent. Choose Tron for stability or Solana for the lowest possible fees.
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates for non-developers. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
How does NOWPayments handle payment verification?
NOWPayments verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook the moment payment confirms. This triggers automatic file delivery without manual intervention.
What happens if a payment fails?
The system does not deliver the product until payment is confirmed on-chain. Failed payments do not trigger file delivery, ensuring security and reliability.
